text:
harper: heads-up: spike in gpu attach waits in us-central at ~02:42 UTC, backlog piling. many pods stuck 'waiting for local device'.
jules: corroborating metrics show NVMe write iops saturated and device %util ~99% on a subset of hosts. saw a sudden chunk of ephemeral-cleaner tasks start at 02:41.
storage-bot: ALERT: nvme-write-util > 90% on 54 hosts (us-central) window 02:41-02:47 UTC. gpu-provision failures +21%.
ops-oncall: any recent autopilot or janitor config changes overnight?
rashmi: we pushed ephemeral-cleaner bump to 4x parallel at 01:50 to reduce GC backlog; thought it targeted only cold-stripe pool. looks like label selector matched storage:ephemeral and stripe:hot by mistake.
harper: immediate steps: 1) scale ephemeral-cleaner down to concurrency=1 on hot-stripe hosts 2) pause aggressive delete jobs on nodes with tag gpu-prod 3) bias new provisioning away from us-central for 30m.
pavan: running: `cleanerctl set-parallel --selector="tag:gpu-prod" --parallel=1 --reason="emergency iops"`
storage-bot: ACTION: parallelism lowered to 1 for selector tag:gpu-prod on 54 hosts.
jules: iops dropped and attach success improved: 76% -> 95% in 10m. sample iostat from node node-c-77: 

Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  await  r_await w_await svctm %util
nvme0n1         58.3   420.1  1024.0  8192.0   6.2   1.1    6.9    0.22  46.2

ops-oncall: opening STOR-7222: "ephemeral-cleaner selector mis-scope -> write iops spike -> gpu attach delays" assigning rashmi + infra-storage.
rashmi: will fix selector and add a dry-run precheck to cleaner scheduler to ensure gpu-tagged nodes are excluded. also proposing an io-softcap (25% default) for high-availability pools.
harper: agree. add alert: local-write-util > 80% AND gpu-attach-failures > 5% -> page infra-sre. also add runbook steps for quick cleaner throttle.
pavan: noted. will add canary gate so parallel config doesn't auto-roll beyond 10 hosts without manual approval.
jules: cost note: throttling cleanup delays reclaimed space -> slightly higher S3 egress for longer GC windows. acceptable tradeoff for availability.
ops-oncall: drafting postmortem template and emergency playbook. closing once root-cause doc is in STOR-7222. thanks team for fast mitigation. :white_check_mark:
